reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 Protocol permissioned issuers and collateral SPVs

sources.label: M0 case study on KAST Dollar

reserveReview.rationale: KAST and M0 identify USDK as a Solana stablecoin built on M0, while M0 documents extension tokens as wrapping and unwrapping the M foundation. The reserve envelope therefore preserves the direct 100% M wrapper dependency and leaves M0 issuer, collateral, and custody details to the upstream record instead of duplicating an unsupported USDK-specific Treasury breakdown.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct M0 dependency is identified, but USDK-specific sources do not publish the current M0 issuer allocation, Treasury holdings, custody-provider split, or a dated assurance report.
